new_result.statement: For the heavy-null exact-rank-three four-bank Walsh Parseval model with h>1/2 and all three spectral singular values at least s, arbitrary independent cap-one original input laws give ||p_Q||_infinity < 609/s, despite complete support overlap of leakage, saddle and third spectral forms.
new_result.mechanism: aggregate four independent original-coordinate banks; after density-cap normalization each bank retains coupling >=s/(2sqrt(2e)), leverage >=1/(2e), and third singular value >=s/e; then use scalar-pivot theorem if any bank diagonal is large, otherwise use the full-matrix indefinite-pair theorem
new_result.rank_two_control: opposite-sign rank-two product keeps its logarithmic singularity; the third direction is paid by the post-aggregation pivot-or-pair alternative, not by assuming rotated independence

mechanism_counterexample: For h=3/4, M=[[0,1,0],[1,0,0],[0,0,1]], and four equal m-coordinate banks, every one-original-coordinate heavy/residual coupling is O(m^-1/2) and local saddle determinants are O(m^-1), while the grouped theorem is uniform. Thus one-coordinate overlap resolution is not a universal proof mechanism.

verification.role: algebraic regression only, not universal closure
